snippet.title: Hotel Giant gameplay (PC Game, 2002)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Hotel Giant (aka maximum capacity: hotel giant), PC game produced by Akella in 2002 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/hotel-giant/10207/
Hotel Giant is one complex game,  very good simulation and management genre puzzle. The player can watch for positive or negative reactions to certain hotel features and make adjustments for a better guest experience.
Played through modern Windows machine.
Recorded with original sound.

Similar videos you may like:
Hotel Giant 2 - https://youtu.be/O-F2T0Y8HP0
